attack_techniques: Hide Artifacts: Hidden Files and Directories (T1564.001)
attackers_goals: Hide malware or staged files from standard file explorers.
description: Hidden attribute was added to a file using attrib.exe, adversaries may set files to be hidden to evade detection mechanisms.
investigative_actions: Check if the hidden file is malicious. Verify if the process executing the command is malicious. Check for more suspicious actions done by the user and process.
name: Hidden Attribute was added to a file using attrib.exe
